required.name: title
required.label: Product name
required.why: The agent has to name the item back to the user and match it against what they asked for.

required.name: price
required.label: Price
required.why: Price is the most requested fact on a product page, and an agent that cannot find it either guesses or leaves.

required.name: currency
required.label: Currency
required.why: A bare number is not a price, and the agent cannot compare it to anything without the ISO currency code.

required.name: availability
required.label: Availability
required.why: Tells the agent whether to recommend this item now or move on to one it can actually get.

recommended.name: brand
recommended.label: Brand
recommended.why: Lets the agent match the item to a brand the user named or already buys.

recommended.name: sku
recommended.label: SKU
recommended.why: Gives the agent a stable identifier so it can re-find this exact variant on a later turn.

recommended.name: shipping
recommended.label: Shipping
recommended.why: Delivery cost and delivery date decide the purchase as often as the price does.

recommended.name: returns
recommended.label: Returns
recommended.why: An agent is reluctant to recommend a purchase it cannot tell the user how to undo.

recommended.name: description
recommended.label: Description
recommended.why: Gives the agent a sentence or two it can quote instead of inventing a summary.
